div.p: Events › Certification · 2027

A professional pathway into teaching TRE™ and building nervous-system resilience in others, taught in Singapore in 2027 by two TRE™ Trainers, Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist. Pick Growth, Foundational or Refresher; early-bird pricing runs until 31 March 2027.

div.span: 21 ICF CCEs for Module 1 with the Growth Package (Module 2 CCEs pending confirmation)Global TRE™ Certification upon completion of all requirements
Packages from S$2,200early bird to 31 Mar 2027

img.alt: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider 2027, boosted by Internal Alchemy, led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist. Growth, Foundational and Refresher packages; modules 24–25 Apr, 3–4 Jul and 30–31 Oct 2027 in Singapore.

div.p: TRE™ is a set of simple, body-led exercises designed to help release stress and tension and to build resilience, by gently activating the body’s natural tremor reflex so the nervous system can find its way back to balance. The Global TRE™ Provider Certification qualifies you to offer TRE™ to the general public, one to one and in groups.

Two TRE™ Trainers, Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist, teach this cohort together, so you learn from two perspectives rather than one. Only one cohort runs in Singapore each year, so reserve your place early.
Three package families, one cohort. Early-bird prices apply until 31 March 2027; each package page has the full instalment schedule.

a.div: S$5,888early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · then S$6,888
a.p: The full certification: Modules 1–3, all online personal sessions and supervisions, ICF credits and the three bonus programmes.

a.div: S$4,888early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · then S$5,888
a.p: The whole certification pathway, minus the ICF credits and the three bonus programmes.

a.div: From S$2,200early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · four options
a.p: For accredited TRE™ Providers and TRE™ Provider trainees who want to complete their training.

div.p: Both packages are the same programme for new students. Growth adds ICF credits and the three bonus programmes.

div.p: For accredited TRE™ Providers and TRE™ Provider trainees who want to complete their training.
div.div: Pay by credit card or bank transfer, in full or in three instalments. Card payments go through Stripe at checkout, and card charges are added on top of every card payment. Early-bird pricing applies until 31 March 2027. Paying the first instalment commits you to the whole package price: instalment 1 on registration (by 31 Mar 2027 early bird, by 22 Apr 2027 regular), instalment 2 after Module 1 (by 3 Jun 2027) and instalment 3 after Module 2 (by 30 Sep 2027). Prefer to pay in full? Alternatively, you can pay the whole package price when you register, by bank transfer or credit card. Card charges apply to card payments only.
div.p: Three in-person modules in Singapore, each paired with online TRE™ sessions and supervisions.
A 2-day in-person workshop plus personal sessions: 2 online individual sessions (led by a different TRE™ trainer) and 2 online group sessions (5 May & 1 Jun 2027, 7–9pm SGT).

A 2-day in-person workshop plus 2 online group supervisions (19 Jul & 16 Aug 2027) and 2 online individual supervisions with a different trainer — building your skills to guide one person safely through TRE™.

A 2-day in-person workshop plus 3 online individual supervisions with a different trainer and 1 online group supervision (13 Nov 2027). The closing module. Finish it, its supervisions and the other certification requirements, and you qualify as a Global TRE™ Provider.

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Somatic and Trauma-informed Executive Coach (ICF PCC), Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and Mindfulness Teacher, trained directly under Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™. Over 30 years of experience across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities — in person and online.

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · Creator of Internal Alchemy
div.p: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer. Simba created Internal Alchemy, which brings breathwork, fascial release, grounding and tremor work together, building on more than 25 years of hands-on work in bodywork, nervous-system regulation and energetic healing, developed in close collaboration with Dr. David Berceli.
One cohort per year. Pick your package and send your details, and Isabelle will confirm your place and email your first instalment link.

div.h2: Joining a session online? Prepare your space
div.p: Your trainer works with you through the camera, so we must see you head to toe, both standing and on the mat. A quick setup before the session makes all the difference.

ul.li: Device about 2–2.5 m away, landscape, roughly hip height — to the side of your mat
A yoga mat, good lighting, and loose, light-coloured clothing (dark hides your tremors)
Reliable internet and the Zoom app, joined a few minutes early
